name: 187. Chat reasoning.summary reaches the Responses upstream (reasoning summary)
description: A chat request served through the Responses API (x-bf-compat convert_chat_to_responses) used to drop reasoning.summary, because the chat reasoning object had no summary field: the upstream got reasoning.summary null, or no reasoning at all when summary was the only field set, so only encrypted reasoning came back. 187.1 and 187.2 pin that /v1/chat/completions forwards it (asserted on extra_fields.raw_request). They use openai/gpt-5.3-codex because convert_chat_to_responses only converts a model the catalog lists without chat completions (plugins/compat markForConversion); gpt-5-mini supports chat, so it was never converted. The /openai integration keeps OpenAI's chat shape, which has no reasoning.summary: 187.3 sends an invalid summary there and expects 200 (it would 400 if it leaked), and 187.4 pins the passthrough route (x-bf-passthrough-extra-params + extra_params) by sending the same invalid value and expecting OpenAI to reject it.
